title: Congress Leader Mani Shankar Aiyar Supports Terror Accused Umar Khalid And Sharjeel Imam From Cockroach Party Stage
summary: Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar and his wife, Suneet Vir Singh, visited the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, where Aiyar’s remarks focused on jailed activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam rather than the NEET examination, which has been projected as the central issue of the agitation.
